Born about 1620, son of John Pabodie, with whom he came to New England about 1635.
Married Elizabeth Alden, daughter of John Alden and Priscilla Mullins, in 1644 and settled at Duxbury,
where he was town clerk 1666 to 81, a selectman, and a deputy to the Plymouth court in most years from 1654 to 1682,
sometimes also pleading as an attorney.
About 1684 he moved to Little Compton, where he was a selectman and an Associate of the colony.
Their daughter Rebecca (1660) married William Southworth.
Eldest child of John and Priscilla Alden, born at Plymouth about 1623
(the Southworth genealogy calls her the first child born in New Plymouth)
. Married William Pabodie in 1644; died at Little Compton, Rhode Island, in 1717.
